name: Hanu Raghavapudi
bio: Hanu Raghavapudi is a director and screenwriter from Bhadradri Kothagudem district known for directing the Telugu-language films.

credits.title: Mysaa
credits.overview: Unafraid of war and unwilling to stop until she finds that one answer. She carries no doubts. Only the ache of an answer she's searched her whole life.

credits.title: Sita Ramam
credits.overview: Afreen, a rebellious Pakistani student sets ablaze the car of an Indian in London. Angered Afreen returns to Pakistan to ask for money from her grandfather that she has to pay in a month's time as damages. credits.title: Padi Padi Leche Manasu
credits.overview: A young couple navigates through the highs and lows of a budding relationship.

credits.title: LIE
credits.overview: A cat and mouse chase between a powerful mafioso and a sharp cop, interlaced with a love-story and some comedy. How a Central Intelligence Officer uncovers the truth of a world famous magician and mimic artist is depicted in this ‘Love Intelligence Enmity’ film.

credits.title: Krishna Gaadi Veera Prema Gaadha
credits.overview: Krishna and Mahalakshmi have been in love since childhood. But he is a coward and she is the sister of a local factionist.

credits.title: Andala Rakshasi
credits.overview: Two men with contrasting personalities fall deeply in love with the same artistically inclined woman, sparking an intense and emotional triangle.
